sourceReview.reason: RWA.xyz now corroborates only the approximate market-size snapshot, showing $14.71 billion and 86,739 holders as of October 18. No primary survey document verifies the article's central claims about 203 respondents, daily settlement problems or a 7% collateral buffer, so the existing story cannot be verified without substituting a different article.
